title: OF2 -- Floating sidebar: the project title must not move when a fragment is open
description: Screenshots 2.webp (a manuscript section) and 3.webp (a fragment) in docs/agent-work/2026-11-11-owner-fixes/, plus 12.png and 13.png (the title crops). Owner: 'with the floating sidebar, in a fragment, the title on the left corner gets moved a bit. spacing isn't right'. With Settings > Floating sidebar on, opening a fragment shows the strip 'Kept from <section> -- <date>' (src/App.tsx about line 1902) and the project title / top-left block and the grey area's top edge end up at a different position than for a manuscript section. Measure the title's bounding box and the sidebar's top in both states, find the rule that differs, and make them identical; the strip itself stays. Likely files: src/styles.css and src/App.tsx, both shared (Edit tool, small regions, re-read first; do not register them). New spec tests/of2-fragment-title.spec.ts asserting the title's x and y are equal (within 0.5 px) for a section and a fragment in floating mode, shown failing first; copy floating-mode setup from tests/floating.spec.ts. Port 1452. Owner hand-test report 2026-11-11 (he tried the real app; his report outranks any passing test). Rules: node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/w9-brief.md, with notes in docs/agent-work/2026-11-11-owner-fixes/notes/<task>.md instead of the wave 9 notes folder. Before your first browser run, grep tests/ for every selector, label and class you change and update the specs that pin them (register each first). Run unit tests and tsc before any trip through the serial lock. Do not edit docs/*.md or AGENTS.md. No commits.
